title: Bottle Height Sorting
abstraction: Discrete-time LTL over scan-cycle states. Numeric conditions are derived atoms; timer conditions use internal atoms mapped to the TON/TOF .Q flag of the reference implementation.
assumptions: The PLC scan is periodic (20 ms in the test cases).
Inputs change only at scan boundaries.
A timer atom becomes true after its configured delay has elapsed.
The reference implementation is used only to validate the specification; it is not shown to the coding agent.

atoms.expression: (HeightSensor < 40.0 OR HeightSensor > 60.0) AND HeightSensor >= 0.0 AND HeightSensor <= 100.0
atoms.meaning: Height outside the accept window but within sensor range

properties.name: In-range bottle is accepted
properties.rationale: A valid height opens the accept gate on the next scan.

properties.name: Out-of-range bottle is rejected
properties.rationale: A valid but wrong height opens the reject gate.

properties.name: Gates are mutually exclusive
properties.rationale: A bottle cannot be routed to both outputs.
